onboardingSubtitle: Income, fixed costs, subscriptions and savings goals in one place — for you alone or the whole household.
onboardingPointEncrypted: All numbers are stored encrypted on this device only. No account, no server.
onboardingPointOffline: The app needs no internet and no bank connection — you enter your items yourself.
onboardingPointDistribution: The split view shows who transfers how much to which account and how to settle fairly.
onboardingPointInsights: Tips point out savings: duplicate subscriptions, payment frequency, interest, budget rule.
onboardingHouseholdText: Add everyone who contributes to the budget with their monthly net income.
onboardingHint: You can add more income sources, gross pay and accounts later in the settings.
